results.title: picoCTF / CyLab Security Academy 2027
results.eligibility_notes: Free global CTF; open to undergrads. US prize pool is restricted to US middle/high-school teams, but global students can compete for score/practice. Persona is undergrad so eligible to play; cash prizes not guaranteed.
results.notes: Official site now redirects to 'CyLab Security Academy' (rebrand announced May 8 2026). Deadline taken from third-party doq.world aggregator, not confirmed on official page.

results.title: Google Summer of Code 2027
results.eligibility_notes: Requires being 18+, a new/beginner open source contributor, and located outside US-export-restricted countries. Remote and paid. US undergrad fits. Exact 2027 dates not yet published at time of search.
results.notes: Official page fetch failed (network error). Info from search snippet + secondary globalscholarshippoint.com. Annual cycle typically: orgs announced Feb, contributor apps Mar-Apr, coding late May-Aug.

results.title: MITRE Embedded Capture the Flag (eCTF) 2027
results.eligibility_notes: Attack-and-defend embedded security competition; teams design secure systems. Open to student teams. 2027 challenge: secure UAV bootloader.
results.notes: Official page fetch was rejected (bot/WAF block) but URL was returned by search. Key dates from search snippet: kickoff Jan 20 2027, last registration Jan 31 2027, scoreboard closes Apr 14 2027.

results.title: NSA Summer 2027 Internship Program
results.eligibility_notes: US citizen required, enrolled degree-seeking undergrad, cybersecurity/CS major fits. 12-week paid program mid-May to mid-Aug 2027. Requires TS/SCI clearance (US citizen persona qualifies). Some postings open Aug 15 - Sep 6 2026 cycle noted on USAJOBS.
results.notes: Verified on official NSA student programs page. Applications for summer internships accepted beginning Aug 15; specific USAJOBS posting 881307600 open 08/19/2026-09/06/2026.

results.title: Social Engineering Competition (SEC) 2027
results.eligibility_notes: Open to high school, undergraduate, and graduate students; teams of 2-4 required. Free, fully virtual. 2027 theme: 'Social Engineering, AI, and Cyber-Physical Systems'. Undergrad track Jan 22-24 2027.
results.notes: Verified. Team applications open Nov 1 2026; registration Nov 1 - Dec 2 2026 (12pm ET). Listed in CISA national repository of cybersecurity competitions.
